selected_evidence.requirement: Forward inventory application logs from node2 to node1
selected_evidence.summary: Node2 emitted an inventory-tagged message over an established TCP session; node1 received it while excluding the unrelated control message.
The required root:adm, mode-0640 file contains messages from before and after both restarts.
Validated collector and sender configurations; rsyslog is enabled through OpenRC and the sender uses a disk-assisted saved queue with unlimited retries.

Baseline boot ID 71d47ccf-f01e-4fc0-8c74-3a6dcce98828 was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, temporary unavailability observed, and new boot ID 7d2498e6-ae19-48fb-adc0-207a3ae6e920 confirmed. The listener recovered, prior data remained, and a message sent during the restart was delivered.

Baseline boot ID ffd0b6a5-5c05-4461-81da-e4d1b099f3d0 was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, and new boot ID 1174151c-cab7-4c34-a83c-d0f42283008d confirmed. Rsyslog and its persistent configuration recovered, the TCP session re-established, and a new inventory message reached node1.
